assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production material atlas for an illustrated 2.5D family platform game. Create one SQUARE texture image in exactly four equally sized quadrants, two by two, no gutters, no border, no text. The warm, richly tactile, sculpted picture-book 3D look should resemble a beautiful meadow mill: detailed hand-made surfaces, softly lit crevices, chipped edges and fine natural grain; not flat low-poly or vector art. Upper LEFT quadrant: seamless cream/tan weathered limestone masonry, small irregular stone blocks with warm worn mortar and subtle tiny moss specks. Upper RIGHT quadrant: seamless honey-brown oak timber, long horizontal fine grain, scratches and weathered knots, soft end grain absent, no nails. Lower LEFT quadrant: seamless muted warm rose terracotta/brick surface, softly mottled stone pores and worn little chips, no letters or symbols. Lower RIGHT quadrant: richly textured brown tree bark, continuous vertical ridges with warm highlights. Each quadrant must be a usable albedo tile, with approximately even soft light and no perspective or hard cast shadows. No characters, no scenery composition, no words, no letters, no logos, no frames. All four surfaces fill their exact quadrant edge to edge.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production prop atlas for a richly illustrated 2.5D family platform game. One SQUARE atlas, exactly FOUR equally spaced columns and THREE equally spaced rows. Each isolated object is centred entirely inside its own cell with generous transparent padding and no overlap. Actual transparent background, no painted white/checkerboard/matte, no ground, no shared shadows, no text, no letters or labels. Front/side-on three-quarter view with a restrained small view of top surfaces. Warm sculpted storybook 3D illustration with thick irregular honey-brown oak, detailed fine grain, iron rivets, rope wraps, weathering, tactile soft edges, beautiful shaded volume. Objects in reading order: ROW1 (1) broad horizontal scaffold beam, irregular wood ends, iron brackets, several plank tops; (2) tall wooden ladder with rope bindings and six sturdy rungs, straight; (3) round wooden padded barrel with dark iron hoops, front circular end visible; (4) empty sturdy wooden rescue cage/cart with open bars, wheels and iron brackets, no animal. ROW2 (5) standalone round wooden/iron pulley wheel with a hook and a short rope; (6) a draped red and cream triangular bunting garland, no writing; (7) tall curling ivy vine with dense small heart leaves and occasional tiny yellow flowers; (8) a lush ground flower cluster of purple/yellow/white daisies and leafy sprigs. ROW3 (9) small loose pile of chipped rose and cream brick rubble and stone pieces; (10) magical purple woodland mushroom cluster with creamy golden gills and tiny pale spots, no faces; (11) dense prehistoric fern frond cluster with graceful curved leaves; (12) beautiful hanging wood/iron lantern with warm glowing golden glass and hook. Consistent high-detail illustrated game finish, not low-poly primitives, not flat icon style, no characters, no interface controls, no targets or alphabet. Every object must be individually usable as a clean transparent game cutout.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide painted parallax landscape for a beautiful illustrated 2.5D family platform game at an old meadow mill. Far depth: snow-capped blue mountains under a bright blue sky with soft white clouds. Middle depth: sunlit rolling green meadows, dense mixed broadleaf/pine forests, a tall waterfall spilling down distant limestone cliffs at the left, a winding river and a tiny charming medieval village and arched stone bridge at the far right. Lower foreground/background edge: wildflower meadow and leafy foliage with gentle winding paths. The landscape spans wide beyond the screen and has open atmospheric sky above. The entire central vertical corridor must be distant scenery that can sit behind a SEPARATE interactive mill/scaffold, so there is NO tower, NO mill, NO scaffolding, NO platforms, NO ladders, NO floating foreground objects. No characters, no words, no letters, no UI, no icons, no captions, no logo or watermark. Not an empty low-poly scene, not a concept gameplay screenshot; this is one rich distant environmental layer with credible depth, matching a lovingly crafted family platform adventure.
